report.success_criterion: On the buggy NumPy revision (commit 723f2fbc453f) in the wasm32/Pyodide environment, `test_abs_nan_signbit` fails because at least one assertion `assert not np.signbit(np.abs(dtype(np.nan)))` or `assert not np.signbit(np.abs(dtype(-np.nan)))` evaluates to False (i.e., `np.signbit(np.abs(...nan...))` is True for +NaN per the reported regression). On the fixed revision of PR #31433, the same assertions pass for all parametrized float dtypes and the array test produces signbit results `[False, False]` for `[np.nan, -np.nan]`.
